description: Lay out the replies you drafted from answer_my_audience so a person can read them. Free, and makes no requests — it only draws what you pass it. It does NOT send anything: each row is a draft, and a reply is posted only after the creator confirms its exact text. Each comment shows with what you decided to do about it and your draft underneath, grouped under its post, so they can work through them one at a time and skip the rest. Call this after you have drafted the replies.

replies.description: One entry per comment you decided about.

draft.description: The reply, in the creator's voice. It is only a draft: nothing is posted until the creator confirms its exact text.

id.description: The comment id from answer_my_audience, so the row addresses the same comment.

kind.description: What the creator should do about it by hand — nothing here acts on their behalf. Becomes the filter chip they triage by.

postUrl.description: The post it was left on — rows are grouped by it.

why.description: Why you decided that, if it is not obvious.

summary.description: What the comment section is asking for, in a sentence or two.

themes.description: What keeps coming up across them.

username.description: Whose audience this is, with or without @.

name: show_audience_replies

byCategory.description: How many comments fell to each decision.

drafted.description: How many rows carry an actual draft reply.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

threads.description: Shaped like search_mentions so one view renders both.

title: Show Audience Replies
